401920308.headline: Norfolk State vs. Georgia Tech prediction: model has Georgia Tech by 22
paragraphs: Norfolk State (2-3) visits Georgia Tech at McCamish Pavilion in Atlanta Tuesday at 7 PM ET on ACCNX.
